text: Fraud Detection and Prevention Systems: Tenders for AI-driven fraud detection platforms, transaction monitoring systems, and behavioral analytics tools used by banks and financial institutions to identify suspicious activities.; fraud detection; fraud prevention; fraud management system; transaction monitoring; suspicious activity detection; AML fraud; payment fraud; identity theft detection; anomaly detection; fraud analytics
reasons: GeM does not have a specific 'Fraud Detection' category; these tenders are typically filed under broad IT/Software categories like 'Computer Software' or 'IT Services'.
